description: Compare supplied SERP snapshots to detect rank churn, top-domain churn, feature changes, and target visibility movement. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

device.description: Device search-result profile used for the analysis. Type: String. Accepted values: "desktop", "mobile". Default: "desktop".

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of change detection across the supplied snapshots; high reports smaller changes. Type: String. Accepted values: "low", "medium", "high". Default: "medium".

snapshots.description: Time-ordered search-result snapshots for the same query and market; supply at least two comparable observations. Type: Array. Minimum: 2 items. Maximum: 30 items. Required.

items.description: One supplied SERP snapshot with its capture time and ranked results. Type: Object. Required.

checked_at.description: Snapshot capture time; use an ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone. The client only checks that this string is nonempty. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

results.description: Ranked search-result records observed in this snapshot. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 100 items. Required.

items.description: One observed ranked result in this snapshot. Type: Object. Required.

domain.description: Website hostname associated with this record, for example example.com rather than a business name. Type: String. Maximum: 180 characters. Optional; no client default.

position.description: Observed search-result rank, where 1 means first. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Required.

result_type.description: Search-result category observed in the supplied snapshot. Type: String. Accepted values: "organic", "paid", "local_pack", "featured_snippet", "ai_overview", "people_also_ask", "video", "image", "news", "other". Default: "organic".

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Maximum: 240 characters. Optional; no client default.

url.description: Absolute URL of the search result observed at this position in the supplied snapshot. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

serp_features.description: Names of search features present in this supplied snapshot, for example ai_overview or local_pack. Type: Array. Maximum: 30 items. Default: [].

items.description: One observed search-feature name, for example ai_overview. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 80 characters. Required.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

target_domains.description: Hostnames whose visibility should be compared across the supplied snapshots. Type: Array. Maximum: 10 items. Default: [].

items.description: One website hostname whose visibility should be compared. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_serp_volatility
title: AgentSEO SERP Volatility Monitor
